item.text: Iron deficiency (ferritin < 100, or TSAT < 20% with ferritin 100–300 and CRP > 10)

To be built at the connectathon — scenario A6: the rest of Diagnosis. Suggest the diagnosis from the findings, so the nurse confirms rather than chooses; A SNOMED CT-AU value set on Ontoserver instead of four hard-coded options; Limited consent or refusal of blood products → Flag; requested target Hb → Goal

extension.valueString:
🚧 To be built at the connectathon — scenario A6: the rest of Diagnosis

  • Suggest the diagnosis from the findings, so the nurse confirms rather than chooses
  • A SNOMED CT-AU value set on Ontoserver instead of four hard-coded options
  • Limited consent or refusal of blood products → Flag; requested target Hb → Goal
Total iron dose (Ganzoni) = weight × (target Hb − actual Hb) × 0.24 + iron stores
